title.description: Title. The original minLength=5 constraint assumed Latin characters — a four-character CJK title (e.g. one meaning water electrolyzer or hydrogen production) is perfectly valid. Relaxed to 2, which only rejects empty values and obvious truncation.

source_db.description: Source database. Crossref denotes a **paper** (kind=paper) retrieved through the Crossref API; the others are mostly patent databases.

tags.description: Axis tags. Since v2 these should be **qualified IDs** (e.g. N1@TGT-0002); bare axis names are temporarily tolerated during migration, and V023 reminds you to complete them

evidence_level.description: Source provenance only; assessment and human confirmation are independent.

role.description: The candidate's role in the evidence chain; definitions are in 00_methodology/glossary.yml

target.description: Owning target ID (the filter key of multi-target gates); see the targets section of 00_methodology/glossary.yml

review_note.description: Basis for manual review. State “which feature was disclosed”, not “it feels related” — otherwise relevance becomes an untraceable self-assertion. Written by patentkit.review apply.

reviewed_at.description: Manual review time (ISO 8601). **Its purpose is disambiguation**: relevance==3 may be ingest's default value (not yet judged), or a human score of 3 (judged). Only this field distinguishes the two. Written by patentkit.review apply.

abstract_raw.description: The retrieved **original abstract** (possibly in a foreign language). Kept separate from summary_zh because summary_zh is semantically a Chinese summary; putting an English abstract there would be a misrepresentation. Source and fetch time are recorded in abstract_source / abstract_fetched_at.

abstract_source.description: Abstract source, e.g. the Google Patents page URL.

relevance_problem.description: The **technical problem dimension** of relevance (manually scored 1–5). relevance is composed from two dimensions: relevance = min(problem, means); see the relevance_dimensions section of the glossary.

relevance_means.description: The **technical means dimension** of relevance (manually scored 1–5). Score the two dimensions separately and then take the min — a differing technical problem cannot be rescued by similar means.

census.description: G-S-04 census evidence: one record per dimension (family / cited_by) proving the lookup was performed and binding the raw artifact. Written by patentkit fetch-bigquery --fill; hand-written records for other sources follow the same schema (see research reference 05).

doc_number.description: The queried publication number (must match the candidate's url_or_doc_number).

source.description: Data source id, e.g. BQ / OPS / EP (free form, non-empty).

status.description: complete/zero_hits count as done (zero hits is a legitimate result); partial/failed do not.
